title: GPT Image 2
summary: OpenAI's flagship native multimodal image generator integrated into ChatGPT, succeeding the DALL-E series. It utilizes an autoregressive architecture and includes a 'Thinking Mode' for agentic reasoning during the creative process.
research_notes: Native 2K resolution support, consistent character rendering across multiple generations, and near-perfect multilingual text capabilities including Cyrillic.

evolution.summary: Transitioned from diffusion-based DALL-E to native autoregressive GPT Image models. Following GPT Image 1 (March 2025) and GPT Image 1.5 (December 2025), GPT Image 2 introduced reasoning loops for planning compositions and high-fidelity typography. OpenAI retired DALL-E 2 and 3 in May 2026.
